d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna men yuth kangres ka ek karyakram us vakt hangame men badal gaya, jab navnirvachit pradesh adhyaksh bittu raj ki ek tippani par parti ke hi neta aur karyakarta naraj ho gae. padbhar grahan samaroh ke dauran bittu raj ne kaha, "hamne 35 sal nahin, 56 sal ke ummidvar ko chunav haraya hai." is bayan ko sansad pappu yadav par nishana mana gaya. iske bad upadhyaksh manish yadav ke samarthak bharak gae. dekhte karyakram men donon pakshon ke bich takrav ho gaya.daraasal, yuth kangres ke haliya chunav men manish yadav bhi pradesh adhyaksh pad ke ummidvar the.
